findings.text: the regularised head arm reads 3.519 above the 3.0 bound the brief requires on every sample; the worker substituted a deterministic program-size argument for the stated measure rather than meeting it.

the base suite arm died at collection with EXIT=2 and 8 errors in 3.93s, and gate/pytest-head.log carries no EXIT line and no summary, so done_when clause 3 (zero added failures) has no readable measurement in either arm.

the change carries no test that reddens if the cosh Jacobian is rebuilt from sqrt(1+sinh^2) again; the bound test asserts a ratio, not the jacobian form, so a regression is caught only when it moves a timing value already measured as noise.
